acceptance_criteria: A committed Coordinator decision reports the RQ-PFDR-ae2fba per-representation table, degree column and yield column measured on the same base with growth arms in log2 p, for every representation this goal admits, or lists each unreached cell with its impediment. A half-cell (degree without yield on the same base, or the reverse) does not satisfy this criterion.

A committed Coordinator decision states whether any representation shows a degree deficit or a yield or coincidence advantage that grows with p, scoped to the tested curves, p, bases, instruments and budget, with the matched null and, for any cost reading, the matched Pollard rho control on the same curves.

A committed Coordinator decision, after independent review, records the reading of the pair-level random model for label-structured bases (H1 of IDEA-20261017-077f12, H-PFDR-011a4b) at its tested scope, and its consequence for the delta of IDEA-20261017-bbc53e.
Tooling readiness, design intake, an assembled ideation batch or an approved but unrun contract never satisfies any criterion above. Each requires a measurement or a derivation with its scope stated.
evidence_requirements: Frozen per-representation conditions and a matched degree/yield table, or an explicit impediment for each unreached cell.

For the current yield premise, original frozen EXP-PFDR-ada71b scientific conditions, independently checked selftest custody, five fresh trial receipts and controls, and independent review of every original claim.
Any cost reading requires a matched Pollard rho control on the same curves; observation of coincidence growth alone is scoped to that measured statistic.

frontier.domain: Public toy prime-order E/F_p point-decomposition representations with fixed curve, base, instrument and budget per cell; current attempt tests pair-sum coincidence growth at 16,20,24,28,32 bits, theta 0.30/0.35 and d 1,2,3.

axes.name: degree or solving-degree deficit against support-matched null
axes.unit: degree or Macaulay rank deficit under stated representation

axes.name: pair-sum coincidence growth exponent delta
axes.unit: slope of log2 kappa on mean log2 N

axes.name: complete matched work
axes.unit: counted operations and memory on same curves

frontier.open_boundary: A valid independently reviewed v2 growth-ladder reading is missing because the pilot provenance was refused. The current recovery isolates that custody gap; degree/yield pairing and any complete-cost reading remain separate goal obligations.

question: Host RQ-PFDR-ae2fba, which had no goal, and build its decision target: a per-representation table for prime-field ECDLP (E/F_p, no Weil descent) whose degree column (first-fall degree, solving degree or its lower bound, Macaulay deficit against a support-matched semi-regular null) and yield column (decomposition probability, coincidence structure, per-relation cost against a matched random base) are measured on the same base, with growth arms in log2 p, and a decision on whether any representation shows a degree deficit or yield advantage that grows with p (alive: feeds a costed relation-collection contract with the matched Pollard rho control) or whether every effect is constant or tracked by its null (scoped kill of the representation channel at the tested scale). The first batch measures one yield-side premise: whether label-structured factor bases (windows and rank-d label GAPs) carry pair-level group-additive excess below the proven range p^(2/3) (EXP-PFDR-ca5e01, H1 of IDEA-20261017-077f12), the quantity IDEA-20261017-bbc53e translates into an exponent shift of the table-table family. Scope discipline: public toy curves only, no deployed target, no private key, and no claim about the security of any deployed curve in either direction; every cell states its curves, p, base, instrument and budget.
scope: Prime-field point-decomposition representations and factor bases on public toy curves, with degree and yield evaluated on the same base under fixed curves, instruments, controls and budgets. The current recovery attempt measures only the 16-32 bit pair-sum coincidence growth ladder; it does not redefine the goal or its later degree and cost obligations.
